svg.title: KRONOS image patch sizes
svg.desc: Four alternative input sizes at 0.5 micrometres per pixel: 32,64,128,256. Crop width increases from16 to128 micrometres. Fixed16pixel tokenization gives4,16,64,256image tokens per marker. For cell phenotyping, the same nucleus-centred cell outline masks each crop before channel normalization and encoding. Outside-cell raw pixels become zero. Each input produces a768value embedding.
